title: An active trader's return
hook: Two stated cases: explore the accumulation of an annual return difference.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the accumulation of an annual return difference affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Balance, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the accumulation of an annual return difference in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
